description: arXiv:2608.00410v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., "bank" or "palm") carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study...
author: Jasin Cekinmez, Addison J. Wu, Raja Marjieh, Thomas L. Griffiths
